goal: Review and Distill the authored UI Prototyping Studio interface-workbench Design into a verified, minimal, evidence-bounded architecture gate. Produce exact change requests or a KEEP result without authoring implementation or granting Plan, SWU-selection, human-study, accessibility-certification, or release authority.
context: The verified current-interface audit found a destructive null-versus-empty polling mismatch plus bounded hierarchy and accessibility defects. Invoke Define is complete and the independent Design denominator/selection fixed point requires architecture, authority, security, state/event, persistence, failure, integration, quality, UX, and validation outputs. The authored target chooses a server-owned projection version, stable no-build shell, keyed region updates, single-flight refresh, identity-bound local context, active canvas/inspector hierarchy, and exact planned witnesses. The prior GSP implementation frontier is complete and must not be reopened; Inventory is discovery-only.
anti_bias_global: continuity mechanics versus whole-workbench contract completeness under claim less than or equal to proof

agents.angle: Computational transition and browser-context falsification methodology. Hewitt/Alexander pair: Hewitt runs canonical-version, single-flight, idempotence, region-patch, focus, draft, and scroll counterexamples while Alexander runs formal interaction-contract and authority reconciliation on the methodology axis; Hewitt's patch-local bias would be exposed by Alexander's whole-system contract coverage, while Alexander's structural-design bias would be exposed by Hewitt's executable transition counterexamples.
agents.initial_prompt: Act as the mechanics, correctness, operability, and narrow-first Distill attacker. Read the complete current Design corpus in the run root: SPEC.md, GLOSSARY.md, DESIGN-SCOPE-MANIFEST.json, DESIGN-DENOMINATOR-RECEIPT.json, DESIGN-SELECTION-RESULT.json, ARCHITECTURE.md, UX-PLAN.md, WITNESS-CONTRACTS.md, VALIDATION-STRATEGY.md, GLOSSARY-CONSISTENCY.md, DESIGN-TRANSPORT.md, CONTEXT-PACK.md, strategy-inventory-packet.json, plus current Studio selectors in backend/src/cli/studio.ts, governed-state-projection.ts, and the two named E2E specs. Inventory is discovery-only. Attack whether the server-computed full/region versions, stable shell, single-flight refresh, idempotent one-transition semantics, local-context reconciliation, safe region rendering, failure behavior, and witness accounting are coherent, minimal, implementable in the existing no-build runtime, and sufficient to prevent the verified reload/context-loss defect. Try counterexamples: poll/action race, duplicated response, current-head change, region-render failure, iframe-local navigation, stale action identity, invalid schema, external CLI write, and unchanged null-staged states. Also attack whether L0 can be separated from later hierarchy work. Do not edit targets. Return CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR candidate findings with exact file/section quotes, one-line fix, KEEP/FIX candidates, survived attacks, and initial/final robot-talk positions. Budget about 2200 tokens.

agents.angle: Formal interaction architecture, UX semantics, and governance methodology. Alexander/Hewitt pair: Alexander runs six-view, ten-output, state-hierarchy, accessibility-scope, and authority-boundary reconciliation while Hewitt runs computational transition and browser-context falsification on the methodology axis; Alexander's structural-design bias would be exposed by Hewitt's executable counterexamples, while Hewitt's patch-local bias would be exposed by Alexander's whole-workbench contract coverage.
agents.initial_prompt: Act as the fidelity, governance, interaction-architecture, and whole-system Distill attacker. Read the complete current Design corpus and strategy-inventory-packet.json, then verify every selected Design output from DESIGN-SELECTION-RESULT.json is materially covered: base architecture, authority/trust, security/abuse, state/event, persistence/concurrency, failure/compensation, integration/versioning, quality, UX Plan, and validation contracts. Attack the six architecture views, lifecycle/action spine, current canvas, contextual inspector, staged review, collapsed history, mobile order, focus/status semantics, safe DOM sinks, iframe boundary, copy, and claim ceilings. Check that each requirement maps to a planned witness; that human, cross-browser, broad accessibility, release, Plan, and execution claims remain outside Design; and that the completed GSP chain is not silently reopened. Test whether the proposal is over-designed for the evidence or misses a state-specific surface. Do not edit targets. Return cited CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR candidate findings, one-line fixes, per-artifact KEEP/FIX candidates, a minimal coherent Design recommendation, survived attacks, and initial/final robot-talk positions. Budget about 2200 tokens.

Synthesize both attackers' complete initial and final robot-talk positions into candidate verified Design change requests. Read strategy-inventory-packet.json and preserve its selected/excluded boundary, gaps, and non-authority notice. Recheck every load-bearing claim against current authored bytes or deterministic Design receipts. Deduplicate by underlying contract defect, distinguish a missing Design obligation from an implementation choice, and drop unsupported findings. For each surviving finding provide exact artifact/quote, CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR severity, one-line proposed fix, and affected selected output. Produce per-artifact KEEP/FIX for ARCHITECTURE.md, UX-PLAN.md, WITNESS-CONTRACTS.md, VALIDATION-STRATEGY.md, GLOSSARY-CONSISTENCY.md, and DESIGN-TRANSPORT.md. End with a Distill verdict: whether the Design is the smallest coherent architecture that closes the verified audit while preserving authority and evidence ceilings. Do not implement or mark Plan admitted. Budget about 2600 tokens.

Falsify every candidate Design finding against the literal run artifacts, the two-pass Design selection result, and current Studio constraints. Reject severity inflation, invented implementation blockers, framework preferences, accessibility-completeness claims, automated human-outcome claims, and any weakening of current-head, staged, acknowledgment, append-only Revert, or terminal-only Export semantics. Check that proposed fixes remain Design changes rather than implementation work and that every selected output and planned witness is accounted for. A verifier turn with no inconsistency must say explicit PASS/no objection; refuted findings are dropped, not softened. Do not edit files. Budget about 1800 tokens.

Act only as downstream coverage auditor. Read the complete working folder after verification. Confirm attacks.md preserves both attackers' initial/final positions and the verifier return; findings.md drops refuted claims, cites every surviving finding, and covers all ten selected outputs, all six architecture views, UX state/responsive/accessibility contracts, every UPW-FIX witness, glossary consistency, Design transport, governance invariants, and evidence ceilings. Fire the zero-findings red flag if the artifacts were not genuinely attacked. Recommend accept or reject to the parent without adding findings or editing targets. Budget about 1400 tokens.
